dict.string: Fittr can look up playlists and MP3s already on this iPhone so you can assign a local track to each exercise. Music library access is optional.
Fittr can add your scheduled workouts to Apple Calendar so they appear alongside your other events. Calendar access is optional.
Fittr can keep workout events in sync if you turn on two-way Calendar sync in Settings. This is optional and off by default.
Fittr can create and update its own workout events on your calendar. It does not need to read your other events.
Fittr can read body weight, heart rate, steps, and recent workouts from Apple Health to show trends. Nothing is uploaded. Health access is optional.
Fittr can save completed workouts to Apple Health so they appear in the Fitness and Health apps. Nothing is uploaded. Health write access is optional.
Fittr can remind you about upcoming workouts and when rest time is over. Notifications are optional and only requested when you turn reminders on.
